summary: QR decomposition of a 3x3 double matrix a1 using Givens rotations over at most 50 iterations, writing results through pointer-offset arithmetic into the output matrices a2 and a3. a3 is first initialized to a 3x3 identity (each row a double 0.0 / 1.0-bit-pattern 1072693248), and a1 is copied into the working buffers and into a2. Each iteration sums the absolute values of the off-diagonal entries of a1 and exits early when that sum is zero; otherwise a shift (0.0 after iteration 4, else the sum * 0.02222222222222222) selects a rotation tolerance, off-diagonal pairs below the 100.0 * |value| threshold are zeroed, and Givens coefficients built from sqrt/1.0/0.5 are applied to the rows and columns of the matrices. Eigenvector/sum contributions are accumulated across iterations into the working buffers and written back through a2. Called from sub_549470 and BoundingBoxComputationFromVertexData on the per-frame path.

local_names.a2: working/output matrix written through offset arithmetic during rotation application
local_names.a3: output matrix initialized to identity and updated through the a2-relative offset mapping
local_names.v71_v72: local accumulation buffers for the per-iteration rotation contributions

operations.description: Initialize a3 as a 3x3 identity matrix: for each of 3 rows memset a 24-byte slot to 0 and write the first dword 0 with the second dword 1072693248 (double 1.0 bit pattern).
Copy the 3x3 input matrix a1 (first element tracked by the field at this+0) into the local buffers v71/v72 and into the working matrix a2 via pointer-offset writes, three columns per row.
Outer iteration loop over i in 0..49 (up to 50 QR iterations).
Compute v12 as the sum of fabs() of the off-diagonal entries of a1; if the sum equals 0.0, break out of the iteration loop (matrix already diagonal).
Select the shift v18: 0.0 when the iteration index is >= 4, otherwise v12 * 0.02222222222222222.

Nested Givens sweep over the lower-triangle entries: for each off-diagonal pair, if the iteration is past 4 and the value is unchanged under a 100.0 * |value| perturbation, zero the 8-byte pair; otherwise if |entry| exceeds the shift, compute and apply a rotation.

Build the Givens coefficients: ratio v29 from the diagonal difference or from 1.0 / (sqrt(v69*v69 + 1.0) + fabs(v69)) with sign flip, then v30 = 1.0 / sqrt(v29*v29 + 1.0), v67 = v30*v29 and v70 = v67 / (v30 + 1.0).
Apply the rotation to matrix rows and columns in a1, a2 and a3 through pointer-offset arithmetic (a1-relative, a2-relative and a3-relative mappings), zeroing each processed off-diagonal 8-byte pair.
At the end of each iteration accumulate the per-column contributions v71[j] += v72[j] for j in 0..2 and write the sum back through the a2 offset mapping.
